name: Gibbering Mouther — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Gibbering Mouther from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Gibbering Mouther", "Mythic Gibbering Mouther" but are not part of the Gibbering Mouther entry, which is unchanged.

From d20pfsrd.com: Gibbering Mouther

Variant: Gibbering Mouther, Goggling Watcher (CR 5)

[Source]

This horrid mass of eyes, mouths, and formless flesh stares in all directions, yet its maws are utterly silent, unlike its gibbering mouther kin. Exceedingly xenophobic, goggling watchers seek to eliminate any creature that is not a goggling watcher. Unlike gibbering mothers, they will form underground communities and wage war on any and all nearby settlements. Goggling watchers worship an insane otherworldly being from the darkness between the stars.

Ranged rays +6 ranged touch; this replaces a gibbering mouther’s melee attacks.

Eye Rays (Sp)

Roll 1d4 for each opponent and then roll randomly on the chart below to see which rays can potentially affect a target. Caster level 4 (equal to the goggling watcher’s HD) and the save DC is Constitution-based.

1. blinding ray (DC 19)
2. dimensional anchor
3. disintegrate (DC 23)
4. enervation
5. polar ray
6. ray of desiccation
7. ray of enfeeblement (DC18)
8. ray of exhaustion (DC 20)
9. ray of frost
10. ray of sickening (DC 18)
11. scorching ray
12. searing light

This replaces a gibbering mouther’s blood drain, engulf, gibbering, and spittle special attacks.

Organization solitary, spectacle (2–6), mass (7-70); this replaces a gibbering mouther’s solitary.

From d20pfsrd.com: Mythic Gibbering Mouther

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee 6 bites +8 (1d4+4 plus grab)
Special Attacks beckoning gibber, blood drain, caustic spittle (+7 ranged touch), enduring insanity, engulf (6d4+6 damage plus 2 Con damage, AC 14, hp 6), gibbering, ground manipulation, mythic power (2/day, surge +1d6)
